intent: From the three affected samples P1, P2 and P3 only (ignore the controls), keep the variants whose alternate-allele frequency among those three samples is at least 0.5.
silent_error: bcftools view -s recomputes only INFO/AC and INFO/AN for the subset; INFO/AF keeps the value of the full cohort (bcftools view usage: '-I, --no-update  Do not (re)calculate INFO fields for the subset (currently INFO/AC and INFO/AN)'). Filtering the subset on INFO/AF therefore tests the six-sample frequency: var2, which no affected sample carries (AC=0), is kept because the cohort AF is 0.5, and var1 (3-sample AF 0.667) is lost because its cohort AF is 0.333. No warning; the output VCF is well formed and contains AC/AN/AF that contradict each other.
